releaseNotes:
🔥 v3.0.0 — The Session Timeline Release

Major:
- Session Timeline Side Box — hour-by-hour timeline, day nav, inline editing, session notes
- Redesigned Sidebar — single toggle button, overlay mode with backdrop

New Features:
- Session name popup on timer start
- Calendar timeline view (day & week)
- Goals tag editor popup
- Frontend auto-update system
- Page placement preferences
- Welcome popup with full app overview (one-time)

UI & UX:
- Timer interaction fixes — sync toggleTimer, no stop button delay
- Minimal mode on first load — no layout shift
- Session side box spacing & timeline dots fix
- Phase words positioned correctly
- Habits & Tasks improvements

Bug Fixes:
- Stop button no longer restarts timer
- Settings button delay eliminated
- Updater.js bundled in electron-builder
